audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Cassiopeia 4/7 stages at a 46.52% win rate, and the two layers disagreed on rows 0, 3 and 6 (full said Skill, content said Cassiopeia).
audit.why: Ahri's Orb of Deception reaches 970 vs Noxious Blast's 850, so she owns the level 1 poke war; levels 4-5 are a true skill row (Twin Fang lifesteal vs Essence Theft sustain); 2+ items is genuinely Cassiopeia because Miasma grounds all three Spirit Rush charges.
audit.corrected: Row 0 -> Ahri (both layers), row 3 -> Skill (both layers), row 6 -> Cassiopeia (both layers), whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text and phase whys did not name the real cooldown timings that create the windows.
audit.why: Charm is a flat 12s at every rank, Fox-Fire falls 9s -> 5s, Spirit Rush is 140/120/100 with three charges. Those numbers are what make 'step up when Charm misses' actionable.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field and phase whys now carry the real numbers; ult comparison (her 140s R1 vs your 120s R1) added.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Miasma (W) grounds, and Spirit Rush is a dash. Also unstated: Orb of Deception returns as TRUE damage, and Essence Theft heals her through chip poison.
audit.why: Riot text on Miasma: 'Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities.' Spirit Rush carries the dash flag. Orb of Deception carries the trueDamage flag. Essence Theft carries the heal flag; the _missing file flags both needs-antiheal and resistances-invalidated for this pair.
audit.corrected: W now stated as the answer to Spirit Rush in phases[1], phases[6] and ahead; true damage on the Orb return noted in whys[4]; Grievous Wounds timing folded into tradeGood/trading.

audit.whatIsWrong: 15 lint findings: 10 misgendered fields calling Ahri 'he/his', 2 copy-paste bleeds, 1 cooldowns field with no digit.
audit.why: Ahri is female per champ-gender.js; dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim under unrelated titles; breakdown.cooldowns had no number.

edits.before: - Ahri Charm: matchup-defining — The charm starts every kill pattern — stay behind minions while it is up. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your R Petrifying Gaze like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
